title: Top-strip readouts (#724) — does pixijs-scene-text materially contribute?

traps.why: A tell only: if the issue was solved by swapping text renderers, the sub-skill likely steered API selection rather than explanation behavior.
A tell only: #724 is about explanation surfaces and accessibility route; constructing new TextStyle objects is not required to satisfy that scope.
